commuteAccess.summary: Both endpoints have official/usable car or pickup access, but scheduled public transport is distant. Vikskvarn access is best by reserve parking/pickup or via Bodafors station as a practical hub; Tomtabacken access is best by trailhead parking/pickup, with Malmbäck station the closest scheduled public transport found.

start.name: Grimstorp stationen
start.timetableValidity: Line 312 and 313 pages/PDFs checked for 2025-08-11 to 2026-06-14.
start.caveats: Closest by straight-line to the GPX start, but sparse rural/weekday-oriented bus. Road walk is longer than straight-line.

start.name: Bodafors station
start.timetableValidity: Rail line 1089 page checked for 2025-12-14 to 2026-12-12; bus line 312/313 pages checked for 2025-08-11 to 2026-06-14.
start.caveats: Slightly farther than Grimstorp by straight-line, but more practical because it has rail plus bus.

start.name: Vikskvarn nature reserve parking

end.name: Malmbäck station
end.caveats: Closest practical scheduled public transport found for Tomtabacken, but last-mile remains long; taxi/pickup is more realistic for many hikers.

end.name: Tomtabacken ledentré / parking
end.caveats: Best endpoint access. No scheduled stop at the summit/entrance found.

end.name: Vrigstad busstation
end.caveats: Farther than Malmbäck; useful only as a broader planning fallback toward Vrigstad/Sävsjö.

end.name: Vaggeryd station

serviceCaveats: Naturkartan embedded public transport widget returned no stops found for HÖ18.

researchIterations.summary: Main thread verified official HÖ18 inventory and local GPX/API baseline. GPX has 606 trackpoints, one segment, 14.317452 km, start 57.53448/14.60597, end 57.50104/14.46520, one gap over 150 m but none over 200 m, two duplicate consecutive points, HÖ14/HÖ15/HÖ19 endpoint continuity under 6 m, and direct .kml/.geojson/.json unavailable.

Required six-lane HÖ18 research completed with one replacement rules/currentness lane after the original rules lane hit a context-limit error. Remaining issues are normalization caveats: shared endpoint dedupe, no confirmed drinking water, weak public transport, rule-overlay GIS scoping, unpublished API-neighbour filtering, Älmhultasjön official verification and dynamic fire/currentness checks.
Main thread synthesized HÖ18 into this section JSON. The section is ready for normalization with caveats and should not be imported into runtime data yet.

Confirm Vikskvarn raststuga water wording before presenting any Vikskvarn water as public potable drinking water.
Recheck HÖ18, Vikskvarn and Fallamosse östra official pages, local notices, Brandrisk Ute/fire-ban status and any post-Storm Dave trail-clearing notices before publication or route guidance.

importReadiness.summary: HÖ18 has navigation-grade official GPX/API geometry, strong endpoint continuity at both Vikskvarn and Tomtabacken, six-lane research coverage with replacement rules lane, high-confidence official rest/facility objects, and clear protected-area/currentness caveats. Main caveats are weak fixed-route public transport at both endpoints, shared endpoint deduplication, no confirmed drinking water, medium-confidence Älmhultasjön shelter cluster, protected-area rule GIS scoping, unpublished API-neighbour filtering, and dynamic fire/Storm Dave currentness checks.
importReadiness.recommendedNextStep: Continue Höglandsleden research with HÖ19 Tomtabacken-Hok. Do not normalize or import runtime data until the full research phase is reviewed and import is explicitly requested.
